title: Common Definitions
description: Shared $defs reused across every module (capex-plan, procurement-plan, project-monitoring, reference-data). Mirrors the live Postgres schema's actual constraints -- e.g. currency is the DB's own `^[A-Z]{3}$` check, not a curated ISO-4217 enum -- so this file stays a true reflection of supabase/migrations/, not an idealized version of it.

currency.description: ISO 4217-shaped currency code. The DB only checks the 3-uppercase-letter shape (`currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'`), not membership in the real ISO 4217 list -- documented as-is rather than tightened, since tightening it here would describe a stricter system than the one actually running.

lookupRef.description: FK -> lookup_options.id. Which list_key is valid depends on the field; see that field's own description. Values are runtime data (editable by any authenticated user), not a fixed schema-level enum -- see reference-data/lookup-option.schema.json.
